objectives: 學習基本天文觀測的觀念.
content: “Astronomy is observational science: many discoveries in astronomy are from multi-wavelength observations. This course will give an overview on the fundamental concepts and techniques in observational astronomy. Most of the materials will be focused on optical astronomy, with few lectures devoted to the observations in other wavelengths.“
